items.prompt: The regulations require that all contractors ___ a safety induction before starting work.

explanation.en: After require that, use the base form of the verb.

optionNotes.en: A that-clause does not take a to-infinitive.
The -ing form cannot be the verb of a that-clause.

items.prompt: It is vital that the patient not ___ any solid food for twelve hours.

explanation.en: After It is vital that, use not + base form.

optionNotes.en: A that-clause does not take a to-infinitive.

items.prompt: My parents insist on ___ us to the airport, even though we've booked a taxi.

optionNotes.en: Insist on cannot take a to-infinitive.
After a preposition the verb needs -ing.

items.prompt: The union proposed that the strike ___ until the talks resumed.

explanation.en: The strike is suspended by someone, so use the passive base form after proposed that.

optionNotes.en: Suspend is active, but the strike does not suspend itself here.
The -ing form cannot be the verb of a that-clause.

items.prompt: I am happy to resubmit the essay, if ___.

explanation.en: If need be is a fixed phrase meaning if necessary.
explanation.es: Es una frase hecha («si hace falta»): if need be.

optionNotes.en: The fixed phrase does not use needing.
Need being is not part of the phrase.
